    Jans: representation-finite algebras have chains of corner ideals #

    For z, z' ∈ e_iAe_j in a representation-finite algebra over an infinite field, one lies in the two-sided ideal generated by the other (mem_Id_or_mem_Id). Otherwise the cyclic modules V_c generated by t = (ē_j, ē_j) in A/I₁ × A/I₂, with z' t = c z t, are indecomposable and pairwise non-isomorphic (Jans, Ann. of Math. 66 (1957), Thm 2.1).
